title: An Empirical Study of On-Device Translation for Real-Time Live-Stream Chat on Mobile Devices
abstract: arXiv:2601.02641v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite its efficiency, there has been little research on the practical aspects required for real-world deployment of on-device AI models, such as the device's CPU utilization and thermal conditions. In this paper, through extensive experiments, we investigate two key issues that must be addressed to deploy on-device models in real-world services: (i) the selection of on-device models and the resource consumption of each model, and (ii) the capability and potential of on-device models for domain adaptation. To this end, we focus on a task of translating live-stream chat messages and manually construct LiveChatBench, a benchmark consisting of 1,000 Korean-English parallel sentence pairs. translated_title: 移动设备上面向实时直播聊天的端侧翻译实证研究
translated_abstract: 尽管端侧AI模型具有高效性，但针对其在真实世界部署中所需实际问题的研究却很少，例如设备的CPU利用率和热状态等。本文通过大量实验，研究了在真实服务中部署端侧模型必须解决的两个关键问题：端侧模型的选择及各模型的资源消耗，以及端侧模型进行领域适配的能力与潜力。为此，我们聚焦于直播聊天消息翻译这一任务，并手动构建了LiveChatBench，这是一个由1,000对韩英平行句对组成的基准数据集。在五款移动设备上的实验表明，尽管服务庞大且多样化的用户群体需要仔细考量高度受限的部署设置和模型选择，所提出的方法仍然能够取得良好的性能表现。
tldr: 该论文聚焦移动设备上实时直播聊天翻译的实际部署问题，通过在五款移动设备上的大量实验，系统研究了端侧模型的选型、资源消耗与领域适配能力，并构建了包含1,000对韩英平行句的LiveChatBench基准数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically investigates the practical deployment of on-device translation models for real-time live-stream chat—covering model selection, resource consumption, and domain adaptation—and introduces LiveChatBench, a benchmark of 1,000 Korean-English parallel sentence pairs, validated across five mobile devices.
